snell.managed: Independent Snell service managed by the agent
snell.help: Requires an agent host with Snell v5 installed. Assign this node through plans. Users share one key (PSK), so Snell cannot tell them apart: with a single user, its traffic counts toward that user's usage and quota, and it stops while that user is disabled, expired or out of traffic; shared by several users, its traffic counts for the server only. Rotate the PSK to revoke previously issued credentials.
snell.pskHelp: Use 16–256 letters, digits or _ + / = - without spaces or line breaks.
snell.regenerate: Generate a new key (invalidates the old key after saving)

inbounds.attachExistingNoClients: No users exist yet. Create users first, then attach them here.
inbounds.detachClientsDesc: Removes the selected user(s) from this inbound only. User records themselves are kept (use Delete to remove fully). Source has {count} users in total.

form.addAllFallbackTooltip: Add a fallback row for every eligible inbound not yet wired up
form.autoSystemRoutesTooltip: Windows-only. CIDRs added to the system routing table automatically so matching traffic goes through TUN.
form.autoOutboundsInterfaceTooltip: Physical interface for outbound traffic. Use 'auto' to detect; auto-enabled when Auto system routes is set.
form.mtgDomainFrontingHint: Where mtg sends non-Telegram traffic — e.g. your NGINX fake site. Leave the IP empty to use the FakeTLS domain via DNS; default port is 443.
form.mtgRouteThroughXrayHint: Send this proxy's Telegram traffic through Xray so it follows your routing rules. The mtg sidecar dials out via a loopback SOCKS bridge tagged with this inbound's tag; reference that tag in the Routing tab for advanced rules.
form.mtgRouteOutboundHint: Optional. Force Telegram traffic out through this outbound (or balancer). Leave empty to let your routing rules decide.
form.mtprotoFakeTlsDomainHint: Default FakeTLS domain used to generate a new user's secret. Each user can front its own domain.
form.mtgThrottleMaxConnectionsHint: Cap concurrent connections across all users with a fair-share limit. 0 disables throttling.
form.mtgAdTagInvalid: Ad-tag must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
form.mtgPublicIpHint: This server's reachable public address, used by the ad-tag middle proxy. Leave blank to let mtg auto-detect it.
form.sessionIDTableHint: Charset for generated session IDs: a predefined name (ALPHABET, Base62, hex, number, …) or a literal ASCII string. Leave empty for xray-core's default.
form.sessionIDLengthHint: Length or range (e.g. 8-16) of generated session IDs. Only used when a Session ID Table is set; minimum must be greater than 0.
form.tcpWindowClampHint: Leave 0 to use the OS default. Non-zero values cap the advertised TCP receive window; values like 600 (from the Xray docs example) can collapse throughput on high-latency links.
form.trustedXForwardedForHint: Trust this request header for the real client IP (e.g. CF-Connecting-IP behind Cloudflare's CDN). Only honored on WebSocket, HTTPUpgrade, XHTTP and gRPC transports. Leave empty to ignore forwarded headers.
form.proxyProtocolHint: Accept the PROXY-protocol header to learn the real client IP from an upstream L4 tunnel or relay (HAProxy, gost, nginx-stream, Xray dokodemo-door) or Cloudflare Spectrum. The upstream MUST emit PROXY protocol. Works on TCP, WebSocket, HTTPUpgrade and gRPC; not on mKCP.
form.realClientIpHint: Capture the visitor's real IP when traffic reaches this inbound through a CDN or relay, instead of recording the intermediary's address. Pick a preset to fill the matching sockopt fields below. These fields are never sent to clients in subscriptions.
form.realClientIpTrustedHeaderTransportWarn: Trusted X-Forwarded-For is only honored on WebSocket, HTTPUpgrade and XHTTP. On the current transport this header is ignored.
form.realClientIpProxyProtocolTransportWarn: PROXY protocol is not supported on this transport (mKCP). Use TCP/RAW, WebSocket, HTTPUpgrade, gRPC or XHTTP.
form.echSockoptTip: Socket options for the connection Xray uses to fetch the ECH config list (e.g. route the lookup through a dialerProxy outbound). Leave disabled to use defaults.
form.curvePreferencesTip: Restrict the TLS key-exchange curves the server offers, in preference order (e.g. X25519MLKEM768, X25519). Leave empty to use Xray-core defaults.
form.masterKeyLogTip: Path to write TLS master keys (SSLKEYLOGFILE format) for debugging with Wireshark. Leave empty in production — it lets anyone with the file decrypt traffic.
form.verifyPeerCertByNameTip: Tell clients to verify the server certificate against this name instead of the SNI. Comma-separated names. Panel-only — included in share links (vcn). The modern replacement for allowInsecure, which Xray removed after 2026-06-01.
form.pinnedPeerCertSha256Tip: SHA-256 hash(es) of the peer certificate as a hex string (e.g. e8e2d3…), comma-separated. Panel-only — not written to the server's xray config, but included in share links so clients can pin the certificate.
form.pinFromRemote: Fetch the hash by pinging the SNI (xray tls ping)
form.pinFromRemoteNoSni: Set the SNI (serverName) first to ping the remote certificate.
form.pinFromRemoteFailed: Could not fetch the remote certificate hash.
form.minClientVerHint: On Xray-core v26.9.8+ empty means no minimum: every client version is accepted, including third-party cores such as Mihomo and sing-box. Cores v26.7.11 to v26.9.7 instead enforce a built-in 26.3.27 minimum when empty; set 1.0.0 there to accept those clients. Set a version to reject clients that report an older one.
form.maxClientVerHint: Empty means no upper limit. If set, it must not be lower than Min Client Ver — otherwise every client is rejected.
form.clientVerInvalid: Client version must be up to three dot-separated numbers, each 0-255 (e.g. 26.3.27)
form.maxClientVerBelowMin: Max Client Ver must not be lower than Min Client Ver
form.realityTargetHint: Required. Must include a port (e.g. example.com:443). Without a port Xray-core refuses to start.
form.tlsCertificateRequired: Import a TLS certificate or enter its file path before saving
form.tlsPrivateKeyRequired: Import the TLS private key or enter its file path before saving
form.tlsServerCertificateRequired: TLS requires at least one server certificate with its private key (encipherment or issue)
form.realityTargetNeedsPort: REALITY target must include a port (e.g. example.com:443)
form.realityTargetInvalidPort: REALITY target has an invalid port
form.scanModalDesc: Validate a domain, or scan an IP / CIDR range to discover new REALITY targets from their certificates. Leave the box empty to probe common candidates.
form.scanDiscoverPlaceholder: IP, CIDR, or domain — leave empty for common candidates
form.scanMldsaCertChainTooSmall: Target certificate chain is {length} bytes, which is below the {min}-byte minimum required for ML-DSA-65. This will cause silent connection failures. Please choose a different target or disable ML-DSA-65.
form.scanPrivateNote: Checked over a private/local network — this address is not reachable from the internet.
form.scanPrivateConfirmContent: "{target}" resolves to a private or loopback address. The check will bypass the panel SSRF guard for this probe only. Continue?
form.spiderXHint: Per-user seed — the panel derives a unique spx path for each user from it; regenerate to rotate everyone's paths
form.afterBytesTip: Let the fallback run at full speed for this many bytes, then start throttling. 0 = throttle from the first byte.
form.bytesPerSecTip: Speed cap (bytes/sec) applied to fallback traffic after the threshold, so probes can't use your server as free bandwidth to the target. 0 = no limit (disables this direction).
form.burstBytesPerSecTip: Allowance for short bursts above the steady rate (token-bucket size). If lower than Bytes Per Sec it is raised to match.
form.listenHelp: You can also enter a Unix socket path (e.g. /run/xray/in.sock), or an abstract socket name prefixed with @ (e.g. @xray/in.sock), to listen on a socket instead of a TCP port — set Port to 0 in that case.
form.shareAddrStrategyHelp: Controls which address is written into exported share links, QR codes, and subscription output.
form.shareAddrHelp: Used only when the share address strategy is Custom. Enter a host or IP without a scheme or port.
form.subSortIndexHelp: Position of this inbound's links in subscription output (sub page and client apps). Lower values come first; equal values keep creation order. Does not affect the panel inbound list.
form.excludeFromSubHelp: Hide this inbound's links from subscription output while keeping the inbound enabled and operational.
form.disableFlowHelp: Opt this inbound out of automatic xtls-rprx-vision injection, even when its transport is flow-capable (e.g. a tunneled XHTTP inbound with VLESS encryption). Clients keep Vision on your other capable inbounds in the same subscription. VLESS only.
form.sharePortHelp: The port people connect to when NAT maps another port onto this node. Links and subscriptions advertise it; 0 keeps the node's own port.

inbounds.intro: Listening ports, protocols and transports, with the users each one serves.
inbounds.mixedUsersNote: Users attached to this inbound log in with their user name and SOCKS5 password, with the same billing, quota, IP limit and expiry as VLESS; the accounts below then stop working.

clients.linksHint: Add third-party share links and remote subscription URLs to include in this user's subscription.
clients.searchPlaceholder: Search email, comment, plan, sub ID, UUID, password, auth, Telegram ID…
clients.totalGBDesc: Data quota for this user. 0 = unlimited.
clients.limitIpDesc: Most networks a user can be online from at once, across all servers (IPv4 counts per /24, IPv6 per /64). 0 = no limit.
clients.ipBansCount: {count} IP banned for going over the limit
clients.limitHwidDesc: Maximum registered devices for subscription requests. 0 = unlimited.
clients.deleteHwidConfirm: Remove this device? It will need to re-register on its next subscription fetch.
clients.clearHwidsConfirm: Remove all registered devices? Every device will need to re-register on its next subscription fetch.
clients.passwordDesc: Used by Trojan, Shadowsocks, TUIC, and SOCKS5 clients; ignored for VLESS, VMess, Hysteria, and WireGuard.
clients.socks5Hint: Not in any subscription. SOCKS5 is not encrypted: use it from abroad or through a VPN.
clients.subIdDesc: Also works as this user's Telegram bot invite code: whoever sends it to the bot is linked to this user. Keep it long and random — a short or guessable ID can be claimed by someone else.
clients.emailInvalidChars: Email cannot contain spaces, '/', '\', or control characters
clients.subIdInvalidChars: Subscription ID cannot contain spaces, '/', '\', or control characters
clients.noSubId: This user has no subId, no shareable link.
clients.noLinks: No shareable links — attach this user to a protocol-capable inbound first.
clients.happLinkErrorHint: The Happ link could not be generated. Retry, or check {page} -> {logs} for details.
clients.happLinkSourceTooLong: The subscription URL exceeds the panel limit of 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Shorten the subscription URL or use Standard.
clients.happLinkQrTooLong: This Happ link is valid, but it is too long to display as a QR code. Use Copy to use the complete link.
clients.happLinkDisabledHint: Enable Happ link generation in Settings before using Happ.
clients.happLinkDisabledTitle: Happ encrypted link generation is not enabled
clients.happLinkDisabledDescription: Enable local generation of encrypted Happ subscription links. (Only for Happ)
clients.happLinkDisclosure: Generated locally. Anyone with this link may be able to recover or share the subscription URL.
clients.resetNotPossible: Attach this user to an inbound first.
clients.resetAllTrafficsContent: Every user's up/down counter drops to zero. Quotas and expiry are not affected. This cannot be undone.
clients.deleteConfirmContent: This removes the user from every attached inbound and drops its traffic record. This cannot be undone.
clients.bulkEnableConfirmContent: Enables each selected user on every attached inbound. Users whose quota is exhausted or whose expiry has passed will be disabled again automatically.
clients.bulkDisableConfirmContent: Disables each selected user on every attached inbound. They lose access immediately but their records and traffic are kept.
clients.attachToInboundsDesc: Attaches the selected {count} user(s) (same UUID/password and shared traffic) to the chosen inbound(s). They keep their existing attachments too.
clients.attachToInboundsNoTargets: No multi-user inbounds available to attach to.
clients.detachFromInboundsDesc: Removes the selected {count} user(s) from the chosen inbound(s). Pairs where the user wasn't attached are silently skipped. User records are kept (use Delete to remove fully).
clients.subLinksEmpty: None of the selected users have a subscription ID.
clients.subLinksDisabledHint: Enable subscription in Panel Settings → Subscription to generate links.
clients.bulkDeleteConfirmContent: Each selected user is removed from every attached inbound and its traffic record is dropped. This cannot be undone.
clients.bulkAdjustHint: Positive values extend, negative values reduce. Users with unlimited expiry or traffic are skipped for that field.
clients.bulkAdjustNothing: Set at least one field before applying.
clients.delDepletedConfirmContent: Removes every user whose traffic quota is exhausted or whose expiry has passed. This cannot be undone.
clients.delOrphansConfirmContent: Removes every user that is not attached to any inbound, along with its traffic record. This cannot be undone.
clients.hysteriaAuthDesc: Credential used only by Hysteria clients. Trojan and Shadowsocks use the Password field instead.
clients.wireguardAllowedIPsHint: Leave empty to auto-assign; separate entries with commas
clients.amneziaWgAllowedIPsHint: Leave empty to auto-assign; separate entries with commas
clients.amneziaWgForwardedPortsHint: Ports/ranges DNAT'd to this user, e.g. 80, 443, 8000-8100. Leave empty for none.
clients.tunnelKeepAliveHint: How often the client sends a keepalive packet. 25 is the usual value: it holds the NAT mapping open and brings an idle peer back on its own after any drop, including a panel restart. 0 disables it — an idle client then stays disconnected until it sends traffic.
clients.mtprotoSecretHint: The user's FakeTLS secret. Regenerate to rotate it.
clients.mtprotoAdTagHint: Optional 32-character hex tag from Telegram's proxy registration. When set, this user is routed through Telegram middle proxies and a sponsored channel appears at the top of their chat list.
clients.renewMaxDesc: How many times auto-renew may fire before the user is left to expire. 0 means no limit. Catching up several missed periods spends one renewal per period.
clients.renewScheduleDesc: Calendar renewal uses midnight in the panel timezone and also resets the user's traffic. Keep independent traffic resets disabled unless an additional reset is intended. Monthly day 1 means valid through the preceding month; day 31 is not the same boundary.
clients.renewUnavailable: The remaining renewal allowances cannot provide a future cutoff.
clients.renewFirstUse: Dates are available after first-use activation. The initial duration is unchanged.
clients.renewNeedsExpiry: An expiry must be set before auto-renewal can run.
clients.renewOnDayDesc: Renew on this day of every calendar month, at midnight in the panel's time zone, instead of every N days. A month too short for the chosen day renews on its last day. 0 keeps the day-interval mode.
clients.tuicTotalGBDesc: TUIC does not support per-user traffic limits; set traffic limit on the inbound instead.
clients.bulkAdTagHint: Enter a 32-character hex tag to set, or 'none' to clear sponsor channel on MTProto inbounds.
clients.intro: Every user with its plan, traffic, status and subscription link. The renewal view lists expiry dates and the next traffic reset.

portal.title: Portal login
portal.intro: With a password, the user can sign in to the portal with their username and see their plan, usage and subscription links.
portal.passwordHint: 6 to 72 characters. Changing it signs the user out everywhere.
portal.handout: Send these details to the user:
portal.revokeConfirm: Turn off portal login for {email}? Their open sessions end at once.
portal.subDisabled: The subscription server is off, so the user cannot open the portal. Turn it on in Settings → Subscription.

clients.renewHint: Added to the later of today and the current expiry. A user without an expiry keeps none.

groups.title: User group
groups.hint: Groups organize users without changing plans, traffic or nodes. Deleting a group leaves its members ungrouped.
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete this group? Members will become ungrouped.

plans.intro: The nodes, rule template and IP limit a group of users share. Each user keeps their own traffic quota, expiry and reset.
plans.serverChangesApply: Nodes you add or remove always reach this plan's users, with or without this option.
plans.deleteBlocked: Move its {count} user(s) to another plan first
plans.unassignConfirm: Remove {count} user(s) from their plan? Their current limits stay.
plans.name: Name
plans.templateHint: The Clash rules in members' subscriptions. Templates live on the Rules page; the default (★) serves plans without one.
plans.reapplyIpLimit: Also apply the IP limit to the {count} user(s) on this plan

codes.title: Activation codes
codes.zeroHint: Validity starts when the code is created, including while unused. 0 means no expiry or no scheduled reset.

nodes.name: Name
nodes.apiTokenPlaceholder: Token from the remote panel's Settings page
nodes.apiTokenHint: The remote panel exposes its API token under Authentication → API Token.
nodes.apiTokenKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current token
nodes.allowPrivateAddressHint: Enable only for hosts on a private network or VPN.
nodes.outboundTagHint: Route this host's panel API traffic through the selected Xray outbound. A loopback bridge inbound is added to the running config automatically and applied live. Leave empty for a direct connection.
nodes.inboundSyncModeHint: Choose which inbounds are imported from this host. Existing hosts default to all inbounds.
nodes.inboundTagsHint: Selection is matched by the inbound tag. An empty selection imports none.
nodes.updateConfirmTitle: Update {count} host(s) to the latest version?
nodes.updateConfirmContent: Each selected host downloads the latest release and restarts onto it. Only enabled, online hosts are updated.
nodes.subNodeTip: Read-only: a downstream host reached through {parent}. Manage it from {parent}'s own panel.
nodes.deleteConfirmContent: This stops monitoring the host. The remote panel itself is unaffected.

toasts.fillRequired: Name, address, port and API token are required
toasts.updateNoneEligible: Select at least one online, enabled host

nodes.tlsVerifyModeHint: How the panel validates the host's HTTPS certificate. Pin or Skip are for self-signed certs (https hosts only).
nodes.mtlsFormHint: This host authenticates the panel with a client certificate. Copy this panel's CA from the Host mTLS section onto the host, set its Trusted parent CA, then restart it.

mtls.title: Host mTLS
mtls.intro: Mutual TLS adds a client-certificate factor on top of the API token for panel-to-host calls. It is opt-in: leave it empty to keep token-only auth.
mtls.copyCaHint: Hand this CA to the hosts this panel manages, then set their TLS verification to Mutual TLS.
mtls.caFailed: Failed to obtain the CA certificate
mtls.trustHint: When this panel is itself a host of another panel, paste the managing panel's CA here to require its client certificate. Restart the panel to apply.
mtls.saved: Trust CA saved — restart the panel to apply

nodes.tlsSkipWarning: Skipping verification removes protection against man-in-the-middle attacks — the API token could be intercepted. Prefer pinning the certificate.
nodes.pinnedCertHint: Base64 or hex SHA-256 of the host's certificate. Use Fetch to read it from the host now.
nodes.intro: The servers this panel runs nodes on, with their status and the probe's live figures.
nodes.kindHint: A panel host is a full 3x-ui panel that this panel calls. An agent is a small program with Xray built in that connects to this panel itself; this panel keeps all of its settings.
nodes.agentHint: Install the agent on the server with the secret shown after saving. The agent connects to this panel itself, so the server needs no open panel port.
nodes.trafficMultiplierHint: What each byte users move through this host counts as toward their quotas: 0.1 counts 10 GB as 1 GB, 0 counts nothing. The host's own traffic figures stay real.
nodes.trafficMultiplierTip: Users' traffic on this host counts {multiplier}× toward their quotas
nodes.agentNewSecretConfirm: The agent using the current secret disconnects until its config file has the new one.
nodes.agentSecretFailed: Could not create an agent secret
nodes.agentSecretOnce: Copy it now: the secret is shown only once.
nodes.agentInstallCommand: Install command (run as root on the host)

generate.publicPortHint: Only when the provider forwards another public port to this one (NAT).
generate.publicPortNeeded: Enter the public port the provider forwards to this node
generate.needNameAndPort: Enter a name and a port
generate.noTemplate: There is no VLESS REALITY node to copy yet; set up the first one with Add Inbound.
generate.hostOffline: The host is offline; generate the node once its agent is connected.

nodes.restartXrayHint: Its connections drop for a moment while Xray restarts.
nodes.disableConfirm: Disable {name}? The panel stops managing it until you enable it again.
nodes.probeNotLinked: Not linked to a probe server
nodes.publicAddressAutoHint: Leave blank to use the public address from the agent’s first connection. You can set an IP or domain yourself.

settings.title: Panel Settings
settings.infoDesc: Every change made here needs to be saved. Please restart the panel to apply changes.
settings.restartPanelDesc: Are you sure you want to restart the panel? If you cannot access the panel after restarting, please view the panel log info on the server.
settings.warnHttp: Panel is served over plain HTTP — set up TLS for production.
settings.warnDefaultPort: Default port 2053 is well-known — change it to a random port.
settings.warnDefaultBasePath: Default base path "/" is well-known — change it to a random path.
settings.warnDefaultSubPath: Default subscription path "/sub/" is well-known — change it.
settings.warnDefaultJsonPath: Default JSON subscription path "/json/" is well-known — change it.
settings.panelListeningIPDesc: The IP address for the web panel. (leave blank to listen on all IPs)
settings.panelListeningDomainDesc: The domain name for the web panel. (leave blank to listen on all domains and IPs)
settings.panelPortDesc: The port number for the web panel. (must be an unused port)
settings.publicKeyPathDesc: The public key file path for the web panel. (begins with ‘/‘)
settings.privateKeyPathDesc: The private key file path for the web panel. (begins with ‘/‘)
settings.panelUrlPathDesc: The URI path for the web panel. (begins with ‘/‘ and concludes with ‘/‘)
settings.pageSizeDesc: Define page size for inbounds table. (0 = disable)
settings.panelOutboundDesc: Routes the panel's own requests — panel/Xray version checks and downloads, Telegram, and the normal geo-file update — through this Xray outbound to bypass server-side filtering of GitHub/Telegram. A loopback bridge inbound is added to the running config automatically and applied live. The Xray-native Geodata Auto-Update is not affected; it has its own download outbound. Leave empty for a direct connection.
settings.remarkTemplateDesc: When set, this replaces the remark model for every subscription link — write your own format with the variable tokens (use the button to insert them). Leave empty to use the model above.
settings.subShowIdentityOnAllLinksDesc: When enabled, {{EMAIL}} and {{USERNAME}} stay on every subscription-body remark. Usage tokens still appear on the first link only.
settings.datepickerDescription: Scheduled tasks will run based on this calendar.
settings.telegramTokenDesc: The Telegram bot token obtained from '{'@'}BotFather'.
settings.telegramProxyDesc: Enables SOCKS5 proxy for connecting to Telegram. (adjust settings as per guide)
settings.telegramAPIServerDesc: The Telegram API server to use. Leave blank to use the default server.
settings.telegramChatIdDesc: The Telegram Admin Chat ID(s). (comma-separated)(get it here {'@'}userinfobot) or (use '/id' command in the bot)
settings.telegramNotifyTimeDesc: How often the Telegram bot sends periodic reports. Pick a preset interval, or choose Custom to enter a raw crontab expression.
settings.tgNotifyBackupDesc: Send a database backup file with a report.
settings.tgNotifyLoginDesc: Get notified about the username, IP address, and time whenever someone attempts to log into your web panel.
settings.sessionMaxAgeDesc: The duration for which you can stay logged in. (unit: minute)
settings.expireTimeDiffDesc: Get notified about expiration date when reaching this threshold. (unit: day)
settings.trafficDiffDesc: Get notified about traffic cap when reaching this threshold. (unit: GB)
settings.tgNotifyCpuDesc: Get notified if CPU load exceeds this threshold. (unit: %)
settings.timeZoneDesc: Scheduled tasks will run based on this time zone.
settings.subJsonEnable: Enable/Disable the JSON subscription endpoint independently.
settings.subFormatsTipDesc: Configure JSON and Clash / Mihomo URL paths, reverse URLs, and client auto-detection separately.
settings.subJsonAutoDetectDesc: When enabled, recognized compatible clients requesting the standard subscription URL receive an Xray JSON configuration array automatically. Other clients keep the raw/base64 response. Requires JSON subscription to be enabled and a panel restart to apply.
settings.subJsonAlwaysArrayDesc: Return the explicit JSON subscription endpoint as an array even when it contains one profile, as required by the XTLS subscription standard. Auto-detected JSON responses always use arrays. Leave disabled to preserve the legacy single-object response.
settings.subJsonUserAgentRegexDesc: Go RE2 regular expression matched against the client's User-Agent to auto-select the Xray JSON format on the standard subscription URL. Empty by default, so auto-detection stays off until you set a pattern for the clients you want to serve. Other clients keep the raw/base64 response. Restart the panel after changes.
settings.subJsonRoutingRulesDesc: Routing JSON, happ:// or incy:// deeplink, or https:// URL. When set, it replaces the JSON subscription's DNS and routing rules (baked into the config for clients that ignore headers, e.g. Happ and INCY with client-side balancers). If the Happ routing header setting is empty, the same profile is automatically sent as the Routing header (inline JSON and URLs as a happ:// deeplink) so clients fetch the matching geo files.
settings.subJsonDnsDesc: Overrides the dns block baked into every JSON subscription config: a full dns object or a servers array. It also replaces the routing profile's DNS in those configs; clients that apply the Routing header keep the profile's resolvers instead. Empty keeps the built-in resolver.
settings.subClashAutoDetectDesc: When enabled, recognized Clash/Mihomo clients requesting the standard subscription URL receive Clash YAML automatically. Browsers still show the subscription page, other clients keep the raw/base64 response, and the explicit JSON and Clash URLs remain available. Requires Clash/Mihomo subscription to be enabled and a panel restart to apply.
settings.subClashUserAgentRegexDesc: Go RE2 regular expression matched against the client's User-Agent to recognize Clash/Mihomo clients on the standard subscription URL. Leave empty to use the default pattern. Restart the panel after changes.
settings.subTitle: Subscription Title
settings.subTitleDesc: Title shown in VPN client. Supports user identity tokens: {{EMAIL}}, {{ID}}, {{SHORT_ID}}, {{SUB_ID}}, {{TELEGRAM_ID}}.
settings.subSupportUrlDesc: Technical support link shown in the VPN client. Supports user identity tokens: {{EMAIL}}, {{ID}}, {{SHORT_ID}}, {{SUB_ID}}, {{TELEGRAM_ID}}.
settings.subProfileModeDesc: Choose which website link is shown in the VPN client.
settings.subProfileBuiltinWarning: This page exposes subscription URLs and node configurations, including for Happ encrypted subscriptions.
settings.subProfileUrlDesc: A link to your website displayed in the VPN client. Supports user identity tokens: {{EMAIL}}, {{ID}}, {{SHORT_ID}}, {{SUB_ID}}, {{TELEGRAM_ID}}. Leave empty to omit the website link.
settings.subAnnounceDesc: The announcement text displayed in the VPN client. Supports user identity tokens: {{EMAIL}}, {{ID}}, {{SHORT_ID}}, {{SUB_ID}}, {{TELEGRAM_ID}}.
settings.subThemeDirDesc: Absolute path to a folder containing a custom index.html/sub.html subscription page template (e.g. /etc/3x-ui/sub_templates/my-theme/). Leave empty to use the default page.
settings.happLinkEnableDesc: Allow encrypted Happ links to be generated in the user QR code window. Subscription URLs are processed locally.
settings.subEnableRoutingDesc: Global setting to enable routing in the VPN client. (Only for Happ)
settings.subRoutingRulesDesc: Paste a ready happ:// deeplink or one permanent HTTPS URL returning a deeplink or JSON. The panel refreshes remote rules in the background and keeps the last valid value, so subscription requests never wait for the source. (Happ only)
settings.subHideSettingsDesc: Hide the ability to view and edit server configurations in the VPN client. (Only for Happ)
settings.subIncyEnableRoutingDesc: Inject a routing profile into the subscription body for the Incy client. (Only for Incy)
settings.subIncyRoutingRulesDesc: Paste a ready incy:// deeplink or one permanent HTTPS URL returning JSON. An HTTPS URL becomes an autorouting profile refreshed by Incy itself. (Incy only)
settings.subListenDesc: The IP address for the subscription service. (leave blank to listen on all IPs)
settings.subPortDesc: The port number for the subscription service. (must be an unused port). Also used to build the subscription link/QR shown in the panel when "Reverse Proxy URI" below is empty — if the subscription is reached through a reverse proxy on a different port, set "Reverse Proxy URI" instead.
settings.subCertPathDesc: The public key file path for the subscription service. (begins with ‘/‘)
settings.subKeyPathDesc: The private key file path for the subscription service. (begins with ‘/‘)
settings.subPathDesc: The URI path for the subscription service. (begins with ‘/‘ and concludes with ‘/‘)
settings.subDomainDesc: The domain name for the subscription service. (leave blank to listen on all domains and IPs). Also used as the fallback domain for the displayed subscription link when "Reverse Proxy URI" is empty — set "Reverse Proxy URI" if the panel and the subscription are reached through different domains (e.g. behind a reverse proxy).
settings.subUpdatesDesc: The update intervals of the subscription URL in the client apps. (unit: hour)
settings.externalSubUserAgentDesc: User-Agent header sent when the panel fetches a user external subscription URL. Leave blank to use the default (v2rayNG/1.8.5). Some providers reject unknown clients.
settings.subEncryptDesc: The returned content of subscription service will be Base64 encoded.
settings.subURIDesc: The full base URL (scheme://domain[:port]/path/) for the subscription link and QR code, used instead of Listen Domain/Listen Port. Set this whenever the subscription is reached through a reverse proxy or a domain/port different from the ones above.
settings.externalTrafficInformEnableDesc: Inform external API on every traffic update.
settings.externalTrafficInformURIDesc: Traffic updates are sent to this URI.
settings.restartXrayOnClientDisableDesc: When a user stops being served - auto-disabled by expiration or traffic limit, or disabled or deleted by hand - restart Xray so its live connections end.
settings.fragmentDesc: Enable fragmentation for TLS hello packet.
settings.trustedProxyCidrsDesc: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs allowed to set forwarded host, proto, and client IP headers.
settings.realityScanCandidatesDesc: Comma-separated host:port targets (or CIDRs) used as the default list when Find Targets runs with an empty search. Customize this with destinations you reuse often.

ldap.skipTlsVerifyDesc: Insecure — disables server certificate validation. Use only with internal/untrusted CAs.
ldap.passwordConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep current password.
ldap.passwordPlaceholder: Configured - enter a new value to replace
ldap.flagFieldDesc: If set, overrides VLESS flag — e.g. shadowInactive.
ldap.invertFlagDesc: Enable when the attribute means disabled (e.g. shadowInactive).
ldap.inboundTagsDesc: Inbounds that LDAP sync may auto-create or auto-delete users on.
ldap.noInbounds: No inbounds found. Create one in Inbounds first.

subFormats.finalMaskDesc: Inject Xray finalmask TCP/UDP masks and QUIC parameters into every generated Xray JSON profile. Requires a client app that supports Xray JSON subscriptions and a recent Xray core.

settings.muxDesc: Transmit multiple independent data streams within an established data stream.
settings.directDesc: Directly establishes connections with domains or IP ranges of a specific country.
settings.blockDesc: Block connections to selected domains or IP ranges using the blackhole outbound.

security.twoFactorEnableDesc: Adds an additional layer of authentication to provide more security.
security.twoFactorModalSteps: To set up two-factor authentication, perform a few steps:
security.twoFactorModalFirstStep: 1. Scan this QR code in the app for authentication or copy the token near the QR code and paste it into the app
security.twoFactorModalSecondStep: 2. Enter the code from the app
security.twoFactorModalRemoveStep: Enter the code from the application to remove two-factor authentication.
security.twoFactorModalChangeCredentialsStep: Enter the code from the application to change administrator credentials.
security.twoFactorModalSetSuccess: Two-factor authentication has been successfully established
security.twoFactorModalDeleteSuccess: Two-factor authentication has been successfully deleted
security.apiTokenEmpty: No tokens yet — create one to authenticate bots or remote panels.
security.apiTokenDeleteWarning: Any caller using this token will stop authenticating immediately.
security.apiTokenCreatedNotice: Copy this token now. For security it is not stored in readable form and will not be shown again.

settings.smtpFromDesc: Sender address used in the email From header. Leave empty to use the username.
settings.smtpFromNameDesc: Optional display name shown before the sender address in the From header.
settings.smtpEventBusNotifyDesc: Select which events trigger email notifications
settings.tgEventBusNotifyDesc: Select which events trigger Telegram notifications
settings.telegramTokenConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep current token.
settings.telegramTokenPlaceholder: Configured - enter a new token to replace
settings.smtpPasswordConfigured: Configured; leave blank to keep current password.
settings.smtpPasswordPlaceholder: Configured - enter a new password to replace
settings.smtpErrorAuth: Authentication failed — check username and password
settings.smtpErrorStarttls: Server requires STARTTLS — change encryption type
settings.smtpErrorTls: Server requires TLS — change encryption type
settings.smtpErrorRefused: Connection refused — check host and port
settings.smtpErrorRelay: Server rejects sending from this address
settings.smtpErrorUnknown: SMTP error — see the panel log for details
settings.ipLimitAllowlistDesc: Addresses and networks that the IP limit never counts and never bans, so a shared office or campus address cannot use up a user's limit. Comma-separated, IP or CIDR.
settings.ipLimitExemptHostsDesc: Addresses of every server, relays included. The IP limit never counts or bans them, and the list follows the servers you add.
settings.ipLimitBanMinutesDesc: A user online from more networks than their IP limit loses the least recently active ones for this long.

subBalancers.title: Subscription balancer
subBalancers.desc: Each enabled balancer is added to the JSON subscription as one extra profile that automatically picks the best of the selected inbounds' endpoints (routing.balancers + burstObservatory in the client config).
subBalancers.sortOrderHelp: Position in the subscription list, interleaved with the inbounds' own order; on equal numbers the balancer comes after the inbound.
subBalancers.weightsHelp: Only for LeastLoad: a lower weight is picked more often; members without a value weigh 1.
subBalancers.errSortOrder: Order must be a whole number ≥ 1

observatory.title: Balancer observatory
observatory.desc: Probe parameters for the burst observatory emitted into each leastPing/leastLoad balancer profile. random/roundRobin balancers get no observatory. Stored as a panel-wide JSON-sub setting.
observatory.destinationDesc: URL the client pings to measure each member outbound.
observatory.connectivityDesc: Optional URL checked once to confirm the member can reach the probe destination. Leave empty to skip.
observatory.samplingDesc: Number of consecutive probes averaged for stability.
observatory.note: leastPing/leastLoad balancers always carry a burst observatory. This switch customises its probe parameters — turn it off to use the built-in defaults. Changes apply after a panel restart.

settings.subCalendarExpireInclusiveDesc: Default off. For users renewing on day 1 with a midnight cutoff in the panel timezone, report the previous month's last second in subscription expiry headers. Actual cutoff and renewals are unchanged. Users use their own timezone and may consider the subscription expired one second early.
settings.subInfoNodeEnableDesc: When enabled, remarks and remaining traffic/days are served as a separate dummy SOCKS config at the top, and expired/depleted subscriptions return only the status config.
settings.subExpiredTemplateDesc: Template for the dummy config when the subscriber account has expired.
settings.subTrafficDepletedTemplateDesc: Template for the dummy config when subscriber traffic quota is exhausted.
settings.subHappAutoDetectDesc: Automatically inject Happ routing and headers when client User-Agent indicates Happ.
settings.subHappProviderIdDesc: Unique provider identifier for Happ client management, remote configuration binding, and migration.
settings.subHappNewUrlDesc: Target URL for automatic client migration. When set, Happ clients will migrate to this subscription link.
settings.subHappFallbackUrlDesc: Backup subscription address used by Happ if the primary subscription URL becomes unreachable.
settings.subHappSubInfoTextDesc: Custom announcement banner displayed at the top of the Happ client (max 200 characters).
settings.subHappSubInfoColorDesc: Color theme style for the announcement banner.
settings.subHappSubInfoButtonTextDesc: Button label displayed inside the announcement banner (max 25 characters).
settings.subHappSubInfoButtonLinkDesc: Target URL opened when the user clicks the banner action button.
settings.subHappSubExpireDesc: Show an expired subscription banner in Happ when the user's traffic or validity has ended.
settings.subHappSubExpireButtonLinkDesc: Target URL opened when the user clicks the renewal button on an expired subscription.
settings.subHappNotificationExpireDesc: Instruct Happ to remind the user 3 days before their subscription expires.
settings.subHappNoLimitDesc: Raise the xray-core RAM limit in Happ for better stability and performance (beta).
settings.subHappAlwaysHwidDesc: Prevent users from turning off HWID sending in the Happ settings.
settings.subHappTunModeDesc: Network stack used by TUN on desktop: system (OS stack) or gVisor (userspace stack).
settings.subHappTunTypeDesc: Core used for the TUN connection on desktop: sing-box, tun2proxy, default (Happ TUN), or Xray.
settings.subHappExcludeRoutesDesc: Comma-separated IP CIDRs (e.g. 192.168.0.0/16, 10.0.0.0/8) to bypass the VPN tunnel.
settings.subHappExcludeApnsDesc: Bypass Apple Push Notification services to maintain reliable background notifications on iOS.
settings.subHappColorProfileDesc: Custom iOS color theme as a JSON string, or resetcolors to restore the default colors.
settings.subHappPingTypeDesc: How Happ measures node latency: via proxy (GET or HEAD), TCP, or ICMP.
settings.subHappLocalProxyAuthDesc: Sends Happ socks-auth-mode / http-auth-mode. Without authorization, any app on the device can use Happ's local SOCKS5/HTTP proxy to reach the tunnel and learn the server address. "Auto" makes Happ generate random credentials; works without a Provider ID.
settings.subHappAutoConnectDesc: Instruct Happ to automatically connect to VPN when the application starts.
settings.subHappAutoConnectTypeDesc: Server chosen for auto-connect: lowest delay, last used, or a random node.
settings.subHappPerAppModeDesc: Control Android application routing: off, on (proxy only listed apps), or bypass (exclude listed apps).
settings.subHappPerAppListDesc: Comma-separated package names of Android applications to include or exclude (e.g. org.telegram.messenger).
settings.subHappPresetApplied: Happ preset applied to routing rules
settings.subHappPresetsDesc: Choose a base preset and optional ad blocking, then apply to replace the current routing rules.
settings.subHappVisualBuilderDesc: Load the current routing profile and edit its rules or full JSON.
settings.subHappEditorListHint: One rule per line. Other profile fields are preserved.
settings.subHappEditorAdvancedHint: Edit the complete JSON profile. Changes sync with the basic rules tab.
settings.subHappEditorInvalidJson: Enter a JSON object. Routing lists, when present, must be arrays of strings or null.
settings.subHappEditorLoadInvalid: The current rules are not a valid Happ routing link or JSON profile.
settings.subHappEditorLoadRemote: Remote URLs cannot be loaded here. Paste a Happ routing link or JSON profile first.
settings.subHappEditorLoadOff: Routing is disabled. Apply a preset or clear the routing rules to create a profile.
settings.subHappEditorNew: No current rules. Start with an empty custom profile.
settings.subHappDeeplinkGenerated: Deeplink generated and applied to routing rules
settings.discordBotEnableDesc: Send system and event alerts to a Discord channel via bot
settings.discordBotTokenDesc: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal
settings.discordTokenConfigured: Token is configured. Enter a new token to replace it.
settings.discordChannelIdDesc: The Discord channel ID where notifications will be sent
settings.discordAdminIdsDesc: Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to run bot commands. Messages from anyone else are ignored, and an empty list turns commands off.
settings.testDiscordDesc: Send a test notification to verify your bot token and channel ID
settings.discordNotifyTimeDesc: How often the Discord bot sends periodic reports. Pick a preset interval, or choose Custom to enter a raw crontab expression.
settings.discordNotifyBackupDesc: Send a database backup file with a report.
settings.discordEventBusNotifyDesc: Select which events trigger Discord notifications
settings.subIncyAppAutoDetectDesc: Send the Incy app-management headers when the client User-Agent is INCY.
settings.subIncyProfileDescriptionDesc: Separate subscription description. Non-ASCII text is sent as base64.
settings.subIncySortOrderDesc: Applies to this subscription on iOS/Android, globally on Desktop.
settings.subIncySupportEmailDesc: Adds an Email button to the subscription card.
settings.subIncyAnnounceUrlDesc: Link target for the home screen announcement.
settings.subIncyPremiumUrlDesc: Premium button in the card; also wins for the banner button.
settings.subIncyBannerTextDesc: Overrides the banner text. Premium providers only.
settings.subIncyBannerButtonTextDesc: Banner button label. Empty hides the button.
settings.subIncyHideUrlDesc: Hides the URL from Share, Copy, QR and backups.
settings.subIncyHideCheckDesc: Removes the connectivity check button from the home screen.
settings.subIncyNoLimitDesc: Memory-tight mode that keeps the tunnel alive under the iOS 50 MB cap.
settings.subIncyPerAppEnableDesc: Enables per-app split tunnelling. Off overrides the user's choice.
settings.subIncyPerAppModeDesc: Proxy: only the listed apps use the VPN. Bypass: they skip it.
settings.subIncyPerAppListDesc: Package names separated by commas or newlines, or a URL to a text file.
settings.subIncyFragmentationEnableDesc: Enables TCP fragmentation, overriding the global setting.
settings.subIncyFragmentPacketsDesc: Which TCP packets to fragment: tlshello, 1-3, 1 or all.
settings.subIncyNoisesEnableDesc: Sends random UDP noise before the VPN handshake.
settings.subIncyNoisesPacketDesc: Payload; with rand, a length range like 10-20.
settings.subIncyResolveEnableDesc: Pre-resolves the server address over DoH before connecting.
settings.subIncyResolveDnsDomainDesc: DoH server URL, usually ending in /dns-query.
settings.subIncyResolveDnsIpDesc: IP of the DoH server, used for bootstrap.
settings.intro: Panel access, security, notifications and subscription settings.

remarkVars.title: Template Variables

remarkVars.descUSAGE_PERCENTAGE: Used traffic as a percentage (hidden if unlimited)
remarkVars.descJALALI_EXPIRE_DATE: Expiry date in the Jalali calendar (YYYY/MM/DD)
remarkVars.descCREATED_UNIX: Creation time as a Unix timestamp (seconds)
remarkVars.descRESET_DAY: Calendar renewal day of the month

settings.subClashRulesMovedDesc: Clash rules for subscriptions are now templates on the Rules page: each plan picks one, and the default serves plans without one and users without a plan.

xray.restartError: There was an error when rebooting the Xray.
xray.stopError: There was an error when stopping the Xray.
xray.generalConfigsDesc: These options will determine general adjustments.
xray.logConfigsDesc: Logs may affect your server's efficiency. It is recommended to enable them wisely only when needed.
xray.TemplateDesc: The final Xray config file will be generated based on this template.
xray.FreedomStrategyDesc: Set the output strategy for the network in the Freedom Protocol.
xray.FreedomHappyEyeballsDesc: Dual-stack dialing for the direct (freedom) outbound — useful on exit servers with both IPv4 and IPv6.
xray.FreedomHappyEyeballsTryDelayDesc: Milliseconds before trying the alternate address family. 150–250 ms is a good starting point.
xray.RoutingStrategyDesc: Set the overall traffic routing strategy for resolving all requests.
xray.logLevelDesc: The log level for error logs, indicating the information that needs to be recorded.
xray.accessLogDesc: The file path for the access log. The special value 'none' disables access logs
xray.errorLogDesc: The file path for the error log. The special value 'none' disables error logs
xray.dnsLogDesc: Whether to enable DNS query logs
xray.maskAddressDesc: IP address mask, when enabled, will automatically replace the IP address that appears in the log.
xray.metricsListenDesc: Expose Xray's Prometheus-style metrics on this address:port (e.g. 127.0.0.1:11111). Leave empty to disable. Bind to localhost and reverse-proxy it — it is unauthenticated.
xray.connectionLimitsDesc: Connection-level policies for user level 0. Leave a field empty to use Xray's default.
xray.connIdleDesc: Closes a connection after it stays idle for this many seconds. Lowering it frees memory and file descriptors faster on busy servers (Xray default: 300).
xray.bufferSizeDesc: Per-connection internal buffer size in KB. Set to 0 to minimize memory usage on low-RAM servers (Xray default depends on the platform).

geoBrowser.title: Geo categories
geoBrowser.emptySelection: Tick categories — they become rule tokens
geoBrowser.pickCategory: Pick a category on the left to see what it contains
geoBrowser.noFiles: No geo databases in the Xray folder
geoBrowser.noFilesHint: They appear after Xray downloads geosite.dat and geoip.dat
geoBrowser.checkFailed: Could not check these values against the geo databases
geoBrowser.parseFailed: Damaged or not a geosite/geoip database
geoBrowser.missingDatabase: Database file not found: {tokens} — add it under Geodata
geoBrowser.unknownAttribute: Attribute not found, the rule would match nothing: {tokens}
geoBrowser.wrongKind: Wrong database kind for this field: {tokens}

balancer.balancerFallbackCycle: Cannot set this balancer as fallback — it would create a circular dependency.

amneziawg.externalInterfaceHint: Host NIC for NAT (PostUp/PostDown). Leave empty to auto-detect.
amneziawg.ipv6SubnetHint: e.g. fd86:ea04:1115::/64. Required when IPv6 is enabled.
amneziawg.ipv6ExternalInterfaceHint: Host NIC each peer's IPv6 address is aliased onto. Leave empty to reuse External Interface.
amneziawg.hHint: A single integer or a low-high range. Leave empty for the classic 1/2/3/4 default.
amneziawg.i1Hint: Optional signature packet. Leave empty to omit it.
amneziawg.headerProtectionKeyHint: Base64 32-byte key; must match on every client config. Leave empty to disable header protection.
amneziawg.contentPaddingAdditionHint: A single integer or low-high byte range added to content packets. Leave empty to disable.
amneziawg.timingRangeHint: A single integer or a low-high range. Leave empty to keep the WireGuard default.
amneziawg.maxHandshakeAttemptsHint: Handshake retries before giving up. Leave empty for the default.
amneziawg.randomTrailersHint: Appends random bytes to every packet. Both ends need AmneziaWG 3.1+.
amneziawg.disableCookiesHint: Never send cookie replies — removes a DPI fingerprint; weakens flood mitigation.

tuic.logLevelHint: Online status, last online and "start after first use" are read from the sidecar's Info lines; Warn or Error turns them off for this inbound.

dns.tagDesc: This tag will be available as an Inbound tag in routing rules.
dns.clientIpDesc: Used to notify the server of the specified IP location during DNS queries
dns.disableFallbackIfMatchDesc: Disables fallback DNS queries when the matching domain list of the DNS server is hit
dns.enableParallelQueryDesc: Enable parallel DNS queries to multiple servers for faster resolution
dns.strategyDesc: Overall strategy to resolve domain names
dns.useSystemHostsDesc: Use the operating system's hosts file
dns.serveStaleDesc: Return expired cached results while refreshing in the background
dns.serveExpiredTTLDesc: Validity (seconds) of stale cache entries; 0 = never expire
dns.hostsValues: IP or domain — type and press Enter
dns.clearAllConfirm: This removes every DNS server from the list. This cannot be undone.
dns.dnsLeakWarning: DNS can leak through localhost, plain UDP/TCP, local-mode DoH/DoQ, fallback queries, or EDNS client IP. Use routed DoH, hosts pins, and disable fallback when privacy matters.

rules.intro: The Clash rule templates plans use. Each plan picks one; plans without one, and users without a plan, get the default (★).

rules.versionRestoreConfirm: Restore this version? The restore is kept as a new version.
rules.previewHint: The Clash config the plan's first user would get
rules.variantHint: Only what differs from the base: a top-level key (dns, proxy-groups, listeners…) replaces the base's; prepend-rules / append-rules and prepend-proxy-groups / append-proxy-groups add before or after its lists.
